name: linkit
description: Publish Codex-built HTML pages and static bundles as public Linkit URLs.

interface.shortDescription: Share Codex-built pages as public links.
interface.longDescription: Linkit turns a single HTML page or static site bundle from Codex into a public Linkit URL. Linkit is currently free. Links expire after 3 days and include a Linkit badge.
defaultPrompt: Turn this generated landing page into a shareable Linkit URL.
Create a 3-day public Linkit URL for this single-file HTML page.
Publish this dist folder with Linkit.
